purpose: Online/connected status overlay for the control-panel connectivity indicator

state_logic.recommended_telemetry_stale_rule: Application-defined timeout based on expected telemetry interval; do not equate an open socket with healthy current data.

animation.note: Prefer steady green with only a subtle heartbeat; avoid aggressive blinking.

flutter_notes: Render in the same 1200x500 scene coordinate system as machine_base.svg.
Do not independently reposition the asset.
Use the top control-panel indicator slot for connectivity consistently.
If warning/error is active, Asset 23 should visually take priority.
Do not use this online state solely from Bluetooth/Wi-Fi socket status if telemetry has stopped updating.
